issuer: the Autoridad del Tránsito y Transporte Terrestre (ATTT)

licence.name: licencia de conducir tipo C (automóviles y camionetas)

note: Read 2026-10-31. The Reglamento de Tránsito Vehicular (Executive Decree 640 of 27 December 2006, Gaceta Oficial No. 25,701 of 29 December 2006), read by eye in the Asamblea Nacional's Legispan scan (no text layer): art. 109, Panamanians and foreigners with authorised residence 'mayores de dieciocho (18) años' may obtain a driving licence; art. 112, type C is for cars and light trucks; art. 117, the licence is valid four years (two from 70); art. 118, those between 16 and 18 may have a provisional permit, valid until the minor turns 18. Legispan's record of the decree lists the norms that changed it since; their titles name other articles, and the three whose titles say only 'modifica' were read by eye in their gazettes: Decree 713 of 2010 (art. 250), Decree 110 of 2016 (arts. 112 and 113, the types and requirements, adding Metro bus types) and Decree 273 of 2017 (fines, arts. 241 ff.); none touches arts. 109 or 117. The fee is Sertracen's (the company that issues licences for the ATTT): a first licence costs B/. 40.00 for women of 16 to 54 and men of 16 to 59 (B/. 36.00 from 55 or 60 to 69), so the fee written is the one paid at 18. The fee is in balboas, at par with the US dollar.

sources.title: Decreto Ejecutivo 640 de 27 de diciembre de 2006, Reglamento de Tránsito Vehicular, Gaceta Oficial No. 25,701 (Asamblea Nacional, Legispan scan)
sources.said: Artículo 109. Los panameños y los extranjeros con residencia autorizada en la República de Panamá, mayores de dieciocho (18) años, podrán obtener una licencia de conducir vehículos, siempre que cumplan con los requisitos establecidos en el presente Reglamento. ... Artículo 117. La licencia de conducir tendrá una vigencia de cuatro (4) años, a excepción de las restricciones que por violaciones al presente Reglamento impongan la Autoridad del Tránsito y Transporte Terrestre y los Jueces de Tránsito. ...
